t.t: Odoo vs TallyPrime: Simple ERP & Accounting Comparison — DataInteger
Compare Odoo vs TallyPrime for accounting, GST, inventory, manufacturing, CRM, eCommerce, payroll, customization, integrations, pricing and business needs in India.

div.h1:
Odoo vs TallyPrime:
Which One Is Right for Your Business?

div.p: Odoo and TallyPrime both handle accounting, invoices and inventory. Odoo is a full ERP with many business apps, while TallyPrime is mainly focused on accounting, GST, inventory and business management.
This guide compares Odoo and TallyPrime for accounting, GST, inventory, manufacturing, CRM, sales, eCommerce, payroll, customization, integrations, pricing and future business needs.

div.h2: Two Popular Platforms, Different Business Needs
div.p: The main difference is how each platform handles accounting, daily work, business apps and customization.

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card dics-kb-compare-card--good h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: Odoo brings Accounting, CRM, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Manufacturing, Website, eCommerce, POS, HR, Project and Helpdesk into one ERP system.

ul.class: dics-kb-list dics-kb-list--good mb-0 list-unstyled d-grid gap-2

li.span: Many business apps in one ERP system
Built-in CRM, Sales, Inventory, Manufacturing and eCommerce apps
Studio, APIs and custom development options

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card dics-kb-compare-card--bad h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: TallyPrime combines accounting, inventory, invoicing, banking, GST, payroll and business reporting, with multi-user and connected service options.

ul.class: dics-kb-list dics-kb-list--bad mb-0 list-unstyled d-grid gap-2

li.span: Inventory, godowns, batches, billing and daily business work

div.h2: Full ERP vs Accounting-Focused Business Software
div.p: Both products do more than bookkeeping. The key question is how much you need from CRM, sales, online selling, operations and business automation.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Odoo connects different apps. A quotation can become a sales order, delivery, invoice and accounting entry. Customer and product data can be shared across apps.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: TallyPrime focuses on business transactions and uses them for accounting, inventory, banking, payroll and compliance reports.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: If you mainly need accounting, invoices, inventory and GST, test those areas carefully. If you need a complete company-wide ERP, also check the wider apps and future needs.
Use this table for a quick comparison. Your final choice depends on your business process, users, integrations and reports.

div.h2: Accounting and GST Comparison in India
div.p: For Indian businesses, check the full finance process, including GST, tax reports, receivables, payables, bank reconciliation, audit records, month-end closing and reports.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Odoo's Indian setup includes Indian Accounting, e-invoicing, e-way bill and Indian accounting reports. Accounting connects with Sales, Purchase and Inventory.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: TallyPrime is built around accounting transactions, financial reports, bill-wise accounting, cost centres, banking and compliance.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Test a full finance cycle: purchase invoice, sales invoice, GST, payment, receipt, bank reconciliation, credit note, debit note, GST returns, month-end closing and P&L.
Both platforms support inventory. Test them using the way your business receives, stores, moves and sells stock.

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: Odoo Inventory supports warehouses, locations, routes, replenishment, barcodes, lots, serial numbers and stock valuation. It also connects with Purchase, Sales and Manufacturing.

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: TallyPrime supports stock groups, categories, multiple godowns, batches, units, stock valuation, orders, deliveries and inventory-linked accounting.
Manufacturers should test BOMs, production orders, material use, WIP, finished goods, job work, costing, quality and reports using real data.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Odoo has a dedicated Manufacturing app with BOMs, work centers and production workflows. It connects with Inventory, Quality, Maintenance and PLM.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: TallyPrime supports multi-level BOMs, raw materials, WIP, finished goods, multiple locations, production entries and job work.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Test a real production process from raw-material receipt to BOM, production, wastage, WIP, finished goods, stock valuation and profit. Check how many steps are still manual.
The two platforms can be quite different for CRM and sales because Odoo has dedicated CRM and Sales apps.

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: Odoo CRM manages leads, opportunities, activities and pipelines. Sales handles quotations, orders, pricing and customer transactions. Marketing and Helpdesk can also connect.

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: TallyPrime focuses on transactions and business management. If you need a full lead-to-opportunity-to-order process, check the required integration or customization.
If you sell online, your ERP needs to keep products, customers, prices, orders, payments, delivery and accounting connected.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Odoo has built-in Website and eCommerce apps. Product, inventory, sales, payment and accounting can work in the same system.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: TallyPrime can connect with eCommerce and other systems, but you may need extra tools or integrations for the online store and customer journey.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Test a real online order from checkout to payment, stock, delivery, invoice, GST, return and refund. Count the systems and manual work needed.
Check payroll using attendance, salary, deductions, statutory reports, employee records, approvals and accounting.

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: Odoo has HR and payroll apps that can connect employee work with the rest of the ERP.

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: TallyPrime payroll supports employee records, salary structures, attendance or production types, payslips and reports for PF, ESI, professional tax, gratuity and income tax.
Both platforms can be customized. The important question is how easily your team can build, test, update and support custom work.

ul.class: dics-kb-list dics-kb-list--good mb-0 list-unstyled d-grid gap-2

li.span: Studio and external API options with the Custom plan

ul.class: dics-kb-list dics-kb-list--bad mb-0 list-unstyled d-grid gap-2

li.span: Custom reports, dashboards and invoice formats
Integrations with banking, eCommerce and other systems
Partner and extension options for business needs

div.class: dics-kb-note mt-4 border rounded-3 p-3 border-warning bg-warning-subtle d-flex align-items-start gap-2
div.p: Important: Custom work adds to the long-term ERP cost. Plan for testing, security, upgrades, integrations and support before starting custom development.
Odoo and TallyPrime have different pricing models. Compare at least three years of license, implementation, support, infrastructure, integration and upgrade costs.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Odoo uses per-user subscriptions. Standard and Custom plans have different features and deployment options. Check Odoo's current pricing before planning your budget.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: TallyPrime offers Silver and Gold license options, as well as rental plans. TSS, cloud access and other services may cost extra. Check TallyPrime's current pricing before buying.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Include users, locations, implementation, data migration, integrations, customization, training, support, cloud access, backups and future upgrades. Compare the total cost, not only the license price.
Where the software runs affects access, backups, security, integrations and IT work.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Odoo's Custom plan supports Odoo Online, Odoo.sh and on-premise deployment. The right option depends on your customization and IT needs.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: TallyPrime is commonly installed on business computers, with multi-user and cloud-access options available.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Decide who will manage backups, security, updates, integrations, monitoring and business continuity.

div.h2: How to Compare Odoo and TallyPrime
div.p: Use these six steps to compare both platforms for your business.

article.class: dics-detail-process-item border-bottom py-4 d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: List your ledgers, GST, receivables, payables, banking, reconciliation, tax reports and month-end reports.

article.class: dics-detail-process-item border-bottom py-4 d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: List your quotations, orders, purchases, inventory, warehouses, manufacturing, job work, returns and deliveries.

article.class: dics-detail-process-item border-bottom py-4 d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Decide if you need CRM, eCommerce, project management, Helpdesk, field service or more automation.

article.class: dics-detail-process-item border-bottom py-4 d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Test sales, purchasing, GST, bank reconciliation, warehouse work, manufacturing and month-end closing with real business examples.

article.class: dics-detail-process-item border-bottom py-4 d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Add license, implementation, migration, integrations, custom work, training, support, infrastructure and recurring costs.

article.class: dics-detail-process-item border-bottom py-4 d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Check future users, companies, branches, products, transaction volume, integrations, reports and automation needs.
Start with your actual business needs, then check which platform supports them with fewer extra tools and manual steps.

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: If you mainly need accounting, GST, invoices, banking, inventory and reports, compare both platforms using real accounting work.

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: If you have multiple warehouses, sales teams, purchasing, stock replenishment, CRM and online sales, compare the full business process.

div.class: dics-kb-compare-card h-100 border rounded-3 shadow-sm p-4 card
div.p: If you plan to grow manufacturing, quality, maintenance, CRM, eCommerce, HR or multiple companies, compare the long-term ERP needs.
Moving from TallyPrime to Odoo is more than importing data. Decide which records, master data and business processes should move to Odoo.

ul.class: dics-kb-list dics-kb-list--good mb-0 list-unstyled d-grid gap-2

li.span: Companies, branches, ledgers, customers and vendors
Products, units, opening stock and stock valuation
GST setup, old reports and required audit records

ul.class: dics-kb-list dics-kb-list--bad mb-0 list-unstyled d-grid gap-2

li.span: CRM, approvals, automation and customer service
Integrations with banks, marketplaces, logistics and other apps

div.p: Do not compare only by feature count. Check both platforms against your real business needs.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Can it handle your GST, reconciliation, reports, audit and month-end work without too much manual work?

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Can sales, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing and delivery teams work in the same system?

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Can it support more companies, branches, products, channels, users, automation and integrations as you grow?

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Can your team and implementation partner manage deployment, customization, APIs, security, upgrades and backups?

h3.button: Q1Is Odoo accounting software like TallyPrime?

div.p: Odoo includes accounting, but it is a full ERP. Accounting connects with CRM, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Manufacturing, Website, eCommerce, HR and Project.
Yes. TallyPrime supports GST setup, GST invoices and GST workflows, including e-invoice and e-way bill features.

h3.button: Q3Does Odoo support Indian GST and e-invoicing?

div.p: Yes. Odoo's Indian setup supports Indian accounting, e-invoicing, e-way bill and Indian accounting reports.

h3.button: Q4Does TallyPrime support inventory and manufacturing?

div.p: Yes. TallyPrime supports inventory, multiple godowns, batches, stock valuation, manufacturing, BOMs, raw materials, WIP and finished goods.

h3.button: Q5Does Odoo have CRM and eCommerce?

div.p: Yes. Odoo has built-in CRM, Sales, Website and eCommerce apps, along with accounting and other business apps.

h3.button: Q6Which is cheaper, Odoo or TallyPrime?

div.p: It depends on users, companies, implementation, integrations and ERP scope. Odoo uses per-user subscriptions, while TallyPrime has license and rental options. Compare the 3-year total cost for the same business needs.

h3.button: Q7Can a business migrate from TallyPrime to Odoo?

div.p: Yes. Migration can include master data, opening balances, stock, receivables, payables and historical records. Test the migration before moving to production.

div.h2: Choose the ERP That Fits Your Business Needs
div.p: Odoo and TallyPrime can both support Indian businesses. The right comparison is based on what your business needs today and what you may need as you grow.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.h3: If Accounting and GST Are the Main Need
div.p: Test both platforms with your real accounting, GST, banking, reporting and audit work.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.h3: If You Need a Full ERP
div.p: Check Odoo's CRM, Sales, Inventory, Manufacturing, eCommerce, HR, Project and service apps against the processes you want in one system.

article.class: border rounded-3 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm d-flex align-items-start gap-3

div.p: Create a data plan, process plan, integration list and 3-year cost estimate before deciding. The goal is a smooth business process after go-live.
